dialogue.origin: 13時からよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: I look forward to our session at 1:00 PM.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそよろしくお願い致します
dialogue.content: Likewise, I look forward to it.

dialogue.origin: 希死念慮が強い相談をお願いできますでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Could you please provide a case with strong suicidal ideation?

dialogue.origin: 承知しました
dialogue.content: Understood.

dialogue.origin: パソコンの動作が遅いので、再起動します少し遅れるかも知れませんがご了承ください
dialogue.content: My computer is running slowly, so I will restart it. I may be a little late; thank you for your understanding.

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です
dialogue.content: That's fine.

dialogue.origin: taihen omatasesiteimasu
dialogue.content: I am very sorry to have kept you waiting.

dialogue.origin: ima nihonngo hennkanga umakuikimasenn
dialogue.content: My Japanese input isn't working correctly right now.

dialogue.origin: 日本語入力ロックかかってませんか？
dialogue.content: Is your Japanese input locked, perhaps?

dialogue.origin: やっと日本語が打てるようになりました
dialogue.content: I can finally type in Japanese now.

dialogue.origin: 良かったです
dialogue.content: I'm glad to hear that.

dialogue.origin: とりあえず始めたいと思います
dialogue.content: Well then, I think we can get started.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: ひとりで子育てが辛いです
dialogue.content: Raising my child alone is so hard.

dialogue.origin: ひとりで子育てをするのは大変ですよね
dialogue.content: It must be very difficult to raise a child on your own.

dialogue.origin: はい、毎日毎日…しんどい
dialogue.content: Yes, every single day... it's exhausting.

dialogue.origin: そうですよねとてもしんどいですよね
dialogue.content: I understand, it must be very exhausting.

dialogue.origin: 何歳くらいのお子さんですか？
dialogue.content: How old is your child?

dialogue.origin: 2歳の男の子です
dialogue.content: He's a 2-year-old boy.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたかとても手がかかる時期ですよね
dialogue.content: I see. That's a very demanding age, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい今も泣いてるけど、抱っこしたいと思えない
dialogue.content: Yes, he's crying right now, but I can't bring myself to hold him.

dialogue.origin: 母親失格です
dialogue.content: I'm a failure as a mother.

dialogue.origin: そう思うと苦しいですよね
dialogue.content: It must be painful to feel that way.

dialogue.origin: はい少し発達に遅れもあって…手がかかります
dialogue.content: Yes, he also has a slight developmental delay... so he needs a lot of care.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: なんで私なんかの元に生まれてきたんだろうって
dialogue.content: I keep wondering why he was born to someone like me.

dialogue.origin: なにかと心配ですよね
dialogue.content: You must have so many worries.

dialogue.origin: そんな風に思われているのですね
dialogue.content: So that's how you've been feeling.

dialogue.origin: 心配だけど、それよりもう、しんどいと思う気持ちのほうが大きいです
dialogue.content: I am worried, but more than that, the feeling of being exhausted is overwhelming.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい、もう、離れたい
dialogue.content: Yes, I just want to get away.

dialogue.origin: でも、母親なのにそんなこと思う私ってサイテーだし
dialogue.content: But I'm his mother... thinking that makes me the worst.

dialogue.origin: そう思われるほどしんどくなられているのですね
dialogue.content: It sounds like you're so exhausted that you've started to feel that way.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 私みたいな母親はいない方がこの子も幸せかもしれない
dialogue.content: Maybe this child would be happier without a mother like me.

dialogue.origin: そこまでご自分を責めていらっしゃるの・・・・・・苦しいですよね
dialogue.content: To blame yourself that much... it must be so painful.

dialogue.origin: 逃げ場がないんですよ逃げ場がないから、我が子なのに叩いたりしちゃう
dialogue.content: There's no escape. Because there's no escape, I end up hitting my own child.

dialogue.origin: サイテーですよね
dialogue.content: I'm the worst, aren't I?

dialogue.origin: 相談できる人が周りにはいらっしゃらないのかな、と思ったのですが
dialogue.content: I was wondering if perhaps you don't have anyone around you that you can talk to.

dialogue.origin: 子育てがしんどいなんて言えなくないですか？
dialogue.content: You can't just say that raising a child is hard, can you?

dialogue.origin: 母親なのに
dialogue.content: Even though I'm a mother.

dialogue.origin: そう思われているのですね
dialogue.content: I see that's how you feel.

dialogue.origin: はいでも、元々頼れる人はいないです、シングルなので
dialogue.content: Yes... but I don't have anyone to rely on to begin with. I'm a single mother.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですねどんなことがあって、今の状況になられたのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. Could you tell me what led to your current situation?

dialogue.origin: 旦那の浮気で、息子が生後6ヶ月の時に離婚しました
dialogue.content: My husband had an affair, so we divorced when my son was 6 months old.

dialogue.origin: 息子と幸せになろうって頑張って仕事してたけど
dialogue.content: I was working hard, determined to be happy with my son, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: （お聴きしていますね）
dialogue.content: (I'm listening.)

dialogue.origin: 発達に遅れがあるのが分かって、療育センターに通ったり
dialogue.content: We found out he has developmental delays, so we started going to a therapy center.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: でもそうなると仕事休まなくちゃいけない日が増えてきて、生活も苦しくて
dialogue.content: But that meant I had to take more days off work, and life became financially difficult.

dialogue.origin: 半年前だったかな…私、倒れちゃったんです
dialogue.content: About six months ago, I think... I collapsed.

dialogue.origin: 病院行ったら、鬱だって言われて
dialogue.content: I went to the hospital, and they told me I had depression.

dialogue.origin: お子さんの世話で仕事もままならなくなったんですね
dialogue.content: So, caring for your child made it difficult to keep up with work.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 薬飲んで仕事して子どものこと見て…
dialogue.content: Taking medication, working, and looking after my child...

dialogue.origin: 本当に苦しい日々を過ごされてきたのですね
dialogue.content: You've been through such difficult days.

dialogue.origin: もう、いっぱいいっぱいですもう、頑張れない
dialogue.content: I'm at my limit. I can't keep trying anymore.

dialogue.origin: 誰の助けも得られないまま、障害をお持ちのお子さんを抱えて、これまでお一人で耐えてきたのですね
dialogue.content: Without anyone's help, you've been enduring this all alone while raising a child with a disability.

dialogue.origin: 本当にしんどい日々だったと思います
dialogue.content: I can only imagine how exhausting your days must have been.

dialogue.origin: はいもう、疲れました
dialogue.content: Yes. I'm just so tired.

dialogue.origin: 子どもの為だったはずなのに、優しくできない
dialogue.content: It was all supposed to be for my child, but I can't be kind to him.

dialogue.origin: 時間にも気持ちにもゆとりがなくなってしまうと、優しくできないのも無理ないと思いますよ
dialogue.content: When you have no room to breathe, mentally or time-wise, I think it's understandable that you can't be kind.

dialogue.origin: これまであなたはお一人だけで、障害をお持ちのお子さんを育ててこられました
dialogue.content: You've been raising your child with a disability all by yourself until now.

dialogue.origin: 十分に努力されてきたと思いますよ
dialogue.content: I believe you have made more than enough effort.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですかね…この状態がこれからも続くのかと思うと、耐えられないです
dialogue.content: Do you think so...? When I think about this continuing, I can't bear it.

dialogue.origin: もう全部なくしてしまいたい
dialogue.content: I just want to make it all disappear.

dialogue.origin: 本当に苦しいですよね
dialogue.content: That must be incredibly painful.

dialogue.origin: もしかして、死にたいと思ったりすることがありますか？
dialogue.content: Do you ever have thoughts of wanting to die?

dialogue.origin: 死んだ方が楽になれるって思ってます
dialogue.content: I think it would be easier if I were dead.

dialogue.origin: この子も一緒に…って
dialogue.content: And my child with me...

dialogue.origin: そう思われているのですね
dialogue.content: So that's what you've been thinking.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それほどまでに追い詰められているのですね
dialogue.content: You must feel so cornered.

dialogue.origin: もう、頑張るの無理ですから
dialogue.content: Because I just can't keep trying anymore.

dialogue.origin: あなたはこれまで、お一人でやれることは十分に努力されてきたと思います
dialogue.content: I believe you've already tried as hard as you possibly could on your own.

dialogue.origin: なので、誰かに頼ってもいいのではないかと思うのですが・・・
dialogue.content: So, I think it might be time to rely on someone else...

dialogue.origin: 誰に、どんな風に頼ればいいのか分かりません
dialogue.content: I don't know who to ask for help, or how.

dialogue.origin: 例えば子育て支援センターというのがあります
dialogue.content: For example, there are places called child-rearing support centers.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: いろいろな事情から子育てに困難を抱えた方の相談にのってくれます
dialogue.content: They provide counseling for people who are facing difficulties with child-rearing for various reasons.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですか…そこまで行く気力もないです
dialogue.content: Is that so... I don't even have the energy to go there.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 薬を沢山、飲みました
dialogue.content: I took a lot of pills.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねいつ飲まれたのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. When did you take them?

dialogue.origin: ここの相談にくる、少し前です子どもの泣き声がうるさくて、耐えられなかった
dialogue.content: A little while before this session. My child's crying was so loud, I couldn't take it.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね今のご気分はどうですか？
dialogue.content: I see. How are you feeling right now?

dialogue.origin: 辛かったんですね
dialogue.content: It must have been so hard for you.

dialogue.origin: ボーッとしてますその方が楽です
dialogue.content: I feel dazed. It's easier this way.

dialogue.origin: お薬の名前と何錠くらい飲んだか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me the name of the medication and about how many tablets you took?

dialogue.origin: デパスを1シート、だと思います
dialogue.content: Depas, one whole sheet, I think.

dialogue.origin: ケースの写メを送っていただけると助かります
dialogue.content: It would be helpful if you could send a photo of the case.

dialogue.origin: デパスですか
dialogue.content: Depas?

dialogue.origin: シート捨てちゃって無いです
dialogue.content: I threw the sheet away, so I don't have it.

dialogue.origin: これくらいはよく飲むので、大丈夫です
dialogue.content: I often take this much, so I'm fine.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 少し安心しました
dialogue.content: That's a bit of a relief.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: さきほど、祖段窓口に行く気力もないとおっしゃいましたが、電話ならかけられそうですか？
dialogue.content: A moment ago, you said you don't have the energy to go to a support center, but do you think you could make a phone call?

dialogue.origin: できるかもしれません
dialogue.content: I might be able to.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 障害を持ったお子さんに関する相談や、子育てしながら働くことの相談など
dialogue.content: Consultations about children with disabilities, or about working while raising children,

dialogue.origin: お話するだけでも気持ちが楽になるかもしれませんし、
dialogue.content: Just talking about it might make you feel a little better,

dialogue.origin: 支援の仕組みなどもあるかもしれません
dialogue.content: and there may be support systems available.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 今は事情は一人で解決するのがむずかしい状況ですので、一人で抱え込まないことが一番大切だと思います
dialogue.content: Right now, your situation is difficult to solve on your own, so I think the most important thing is not to carry it all by yourself.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 是非、いろいろと相談してみてください
dialogue.content: Please, do try to talk to them about various things.

dialogue.origin: わかりました
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: ここにも、あなたの辛いお気持ちをまたお話に来て下さいね
dialogue.content: And please come back here to talk about your painful feelings again, anytime.

dialogue.origin: はいありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 今日は相談にきてくださりありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming to talk with me today.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: それでは終了メッセージをお送りします。
dialogue.content: I will now send the closing message.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: （お疲れさまでした。いろいろと勉強になりました。改善点など、忌憚なくご指摘ください。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (Good work. I learned a lot. Please don't hesitate to point out any areas for improvement. Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: （お疲れさまでした。こちらこそ、勉強させていただきました。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (Good work. I learned a lot as well. Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: （初めにゴタゴタがあり、ちょっと短めですが終わりにしたいと思います。よろしいでしょうか？）
dialogue.content: (We had some trouble at the beginning, so it's a bit short, but I'd like to end it here. Is that alright?)

dialogue.origin: （私の方は大丈夫です。お気遣いありがとうございます）
dialogue.content: (That's fine with me. Thank you for your consideration.)

dialogue.origin: （それでは終了します。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (Then we will conclude here. Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you.)

topic.sub: シングルマザーとしての子育ての辛さ
